text: Halt! Stop right there! Get back! Not one step closer!
instruction: A noble adult male elf with a refined light baritone, warm resonance and clear diction. He is a warden of the forest shouting sharp battle commands at an intruder: loud, projected, urgent commands at full voice, each word hurled out with force, a hard attack and a sharp falling ending. Raised pitch, strong breath, no calm. An elegant British English accent. Shouted spoken dialogue, not singing; no growl, gravel, screaming distortion or background sound.
status: owner accepted 2026-10-25 as the shouted warden guide (not a clone of the actor)
